test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Under which of the following schemes, do the designated states procure, store and issue food grains under the Targeted Public Distribution System?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Decentralised Procurement Scheme.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Under **Decentralized Procurement Scheme (DCP)**, food grains is made up and give out by the State Governments themselves.
 
• Under this scheme,** the nominated DCP States procure, store and issue foodgrains** under the **Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS) and other welfare schemes of the Central Government of India.**

• ​Minimum support prize are **the prices at which the government obtain certain crops from farmers to assure them opposed to any sharp fall in prices**.
 
• Under a centralised procurement scheme, **the appointed States procure, store and also issue foodgrains as per allotments indicated by the Central Government under TPDS.**
 
• **The prize stabilisation fund **is **aimed to increase or decrease the low or high prices of such sort out materials by distributing or procuring the material to stabilize the price in a range**
